SCIENCE ADVENTURE 6 · CLASS 31

Owl’s Day and Night Discovery

Age 4–5 YearsClass 31 · ScienceSkill Day and night

Football in the sun, a sleeping child, butterflies at noon, an owl at midnight — DAY or NIGHT?

Play the science game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · DAY AND NIGHT

Owl’s Day and Night Discovery

Look at each picture. Does it happen in the DAY or at NIGHT? Tap your answer!

A boy plays football under a big smiling sun. Day or night?

A child sleeps under a crescent moon and stars. Day or night?

Butterflies flutter over flowers in bright sunshine. Day or night?

An owl watches from its branch under the moon. Day or night?

Day and night sorted!

The football game and butterflies happen by day; sleeping and the owl happen at night.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Day/night sorting links science to a child’s own routine. Ask when THEY do each thing — breakfast is a day thing, and so is the school run.

Prefer paper? The Owl’s Day and Night Discovery worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
